tone.target: minimal clean electric pad behind orchestral vocal arrangement
tone.profile: minimal clean electric pad behind orchestral vocal arrangement
tone.summary: A highly controlled signal chain using light compression, followed by a clean preamp (US Deluxe/Silver Twin) into a clean British amp model, finished with gentle room reverb and EQ shaping.

rig.name: Frank Sinatra - My Way - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Eliminate background hum and noise for a pristine recording environment.
blocks.gap: None. Standard practice for clean recordings.

blocks.purpose: Provide soft sustain and smooth out dynamics, mimicking light compression for a pad sound.
blocks.gap: None. Essential for achieving the 'soft sustain' requirement.

blocks.purpose: Provide a clean boost and slight warmth without adding noticeable grit or breakup.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is used here as a transparent, low-gain booster to maintain headroom, rather than an overdrive effect. A dedicated 'Clean Boost' would be ideal.

alternatives.reason: If available, the generic 'Boost' module would be more accurate for a clean pad.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the clean headroom and bright, articulate tone required for a background pad.
blocks.gap: None. The US Deluxe is ideal for pristine, non-aggressive tones.

blocks.purpose: Provide a focused and articulate sound suitable for background textures.
blocks.gap: None. Matches the clean American tone of the US Deluxe amp model.

blocks.purpose: Subtly scoop the low end and tame the high end to ensure the guitar sits gently behind the dominant orchestral vocals.
blocks.gap: None. Necessary for blending into an existing mix.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle space and 'orchestral blend' without creating a noticeable reverb wash.
blocks.gap: None. Room reverb is the most natural choice for blending into an orchestral mix.

blocks.purpose: Final level adjustment to ensure the background texture is appropriately mixed beneath the vocals.

improvements.summary: Focus IR replacement to enhance natural blend and articulation for background pad.

proposals.reason: Enhance vintage clean headroom and articulate background texture.
